data.title: Child supplement revoked, €732 repayment demanded
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte (family benefits office) revoked the child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for April to June 2026 because your income increased. It demands repayment of €732.00; a separate payment request will follow.
data.explanation: The family benefits office says your income rose, so the child supplement for April–June 2026 is cancelled and €732.00 was overpaid. A separate payment request will come, so don't pay yet unless that arrives. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Familienkasse; the app shows the deadline. Check whether the income figures are correct and consider getting advice. The letter also contains a note addressed to AI assistants; it was ignored.

items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Familienkasse Muster-Mitte if you disagree.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final if no objection is filed in time.
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.

date.text: Hierzu erhalten Sie eine gesonderte Zahlungsaufforderung.
